facts.summary: Interim analysis showed no separation from placebo due to high placebo response · Phase 1b · IMU-935 in psoriasis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the group averages for Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI) reductions in the two active arms did not separate from placebo at four weeks.
evidence.safety: administration of IMU-935 and placebo in this trial were demonstrated to be safe and well-tolerated, and no new safety signals were observed.
evidence.program_discontinued: Company Expects to Continue IMU-935 Development in Psoriasis
